appDetails.name: SHHH – Read in silence
appDetails.shortDescription: The reader that needs silence. Read books and web; noise punishes reading.
appDetails.description:
Transform your reading with ambient noise control. Features 3 reading modes (threshold, fade), PDF/ePub/TXT/MD support, browser, streaks, and 100% offline reading. Your audio never leaves your device.

Features:
• Threshold & Fade noise modes
• PDF, ePub, TXT, MD, HTML reading
• Browser with noise-aware browsing
• Streaks & statistics
• Share your silence stats
• 100% offline
• No account required

Permissions:
• Microphone — to monitor ambient noise (processed on-device only)
• Files — to open shared documents
